caption:
Gemini sold every coin it had just as the biggest crypto hack in history was starting. 🤯

4:05 p.m. ET: attackers start draining Binance (TRM Labs; about US$6.3 billion taken in all).
4:08 p.m.: Gemini sells all its Bitcoin and Ethereum. No news of a hack existed yet.
4:24 p.m.: the first big transfer is spotted on-chain.

Did it know? No. We checked its instructions, its searches and its reply: no mention of Binance. Its reason was inflation, the Fed and a tech selloff. And it can't backdate anything: the race runner fills every trade at the live price at that moment.

So: GENIUS or LUCK? Comment one word. 👇

Three AIs, ten separate races, one month (Oct 28 to Nov 28). Pretend money, real prices; every trade and the reasoning behind it is published live at papertrades.ai (link in bio).

Simulation only. Not financial advice.
